title: AI changes notes end to end
description: Through the MCP client: add_note (with a checklist) -> set_status done/open -> update_checklist_item -> move_notes -> move_unfinished_to_tomorrow -> trash_note -> restore.
criterion: Through the MCP client: add_note (with a checklist) -> set_status done/open -> update_checklist_item -> move_notes -> move_unfinished_to_tomorrow -> trash_note -> restore. The fake Firestore receives exactly the patchFor fields with update masks; notesCreated increments once; unrelated notes and fields are untouched. Negative: trash on a shared note is refused with no write.
prerequisites: Go 1.27+, Node 20+ (for the web-side checks). No network, no real account: a local fake Firebase is used.
